detailed_description: Morse Code is a browser-side encoder and decoder over a built-in lookup table. Text is converted by uppercasing each character and joining their dot/dash codes with single spaces; unknown characters pass through unchanged. Morse is decoded by splitting on spaces, mapping each token back to its character, and treating a forward slash as a word break. A Play button uses the Web Audio API to sound 600 Hz tones with fixed dot, dash, and pause durations. Each panel has a Copy button, and a small reference grid shows the first 36 character mappings. The tool does not configure WPM, prosigns, diacritical marks, file download, or strict ITU-spec timing.
usage_steps: Type plain text in the left panel and click To Morse to fill the right panel with dot/dash codes
Or paste Morse in the right panel using spaces between characters and / for word breaks, then click To Text
Use Copy on either panel to copy the current text or Morse value to the clipboard
Click Play to hear the Morse value as 600 Hz tones via the Web Audio API
Refer to the small reference grid below to look up basic character codes
usage_examples: Encode a short message like SOS or a name and copy the dot/dash output
Decode a Morse string a friend sent back to plain text
Click Play to listen to a short Morse sequence as audio tones
Look up the codes for a few letters using the small reference grid
